import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0053 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0053 (a b c d : Nat) (h1 : a ∣ b) (h2 : c ∣ d) : a * c ∣ b * d := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨l, hk2⟩ := h2
  have : b * d = (k * b) * (l * d) := by ring
  rw [this]
  have : (k * b) * (l * d) = (k * l) * (b * d) := by ring
  have : (k * l) * (b * d) = (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) := by
    rw [hk1, mul_assoc, mul_comm b (b / a), mul_assoc, mul_comm a (b / a)]
  have : (k * l) * (a * (b / a) * d) = (k * l * a) * (b / a * d) := by ring
  have : (k * l * a) * (b / a * d) = (a * c) * (b / a * d) := by
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm k l a, mul_assoc, mul_comm a c, mul_assoc, mul_comm (b / a) d]
  exact this
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0053 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0053 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
